items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I know that Charlie Parker was. I know that because he told me so.

ctx.x: I don't know, but I would be one bit surprised. Whiteman with Gershwin.
Most people who get involved seriously with their horn are not turned off by this, and even more sparked by it; I know that Charlie Parker was. I know that because he told me so.
Most of the harmonic things that have come into jazz in the last forty years have come from twentieth century classical music.
